cards.a: May cause cardiomyopathy, myelosuppression, secondary malignancies; Extravasation can result in severe local tissue injury and necrosis

cards.q: What is the Other Note for doxorubicin (Adriamycin)?
cards.a: May cause red discoloration of urine, tears, sweat, and saliva

cards.q: What are the Key Side Effects of pembrolizumab, pembrolizumab/berahyaluronidase alfa-pmph (Keytruda, Keytruda Qlex)?
cards.a: Peripheral edema; Immune-related adverse events (including pruritus, skin rash, endocrine and metabolic abnormalities, diarrhea, increased liver enzymes, increased serum creatinine, dyspnea); Nausea; Vomiting; Hematuria; Anemia; Fatigue; Musculoskeletal pain

cards.q: What are the Key Side Effects of anastrozole (Arimidex)?
cards.a: Fatigue; Rash; Flushing; Hot flashes; Arthralgia; Nausea; Vomiting; Hypertension; Peripheral edema; Osteoporosis

cards.q: What are the Other Notes for anastrozole (Arimidex)?
cards.a: Cardiovascular side effects (i.e., hypercholesterolemia, coronary artery disease (CAD)); Fetal toxicity (CI in pregnancy)

cards.q: What are the Key Side Effects of tamoxifen (Soltamox)?
cards.a: Hot flashes/night sweats; Vaginal bleeding/discharge; Decreased bone density (in premenopausal females)

cards.q: What are the US Boxed Warnings of tamoxifen (Soltamox)?
cards.a: Increased risk for uterine or endometrial cancer and thromboembolic events

cards.q: What are the Other Notes for tamoxifen (Soltamox)?
cards.a: Contraception should be used in premenopausal females due to teratogenicity of the drug; Do not use with warfarin or history deep vein thrombosis/pulmonary embolism (DVT/PE)
